name: Vigor Stoneload
description: Stand at the twin cups of a paired catapult with the feet set so either arm is a single pace away.

name: Armcupgift
description: Weigh two stones in the hands at once and match them to the pair of cups.

name: Luminous Axlepin
description: Breathe in step with the second winder so the pair of cranks turn on one beat.

name: Compassionate Torsion
description: Lift both stones into their cups with a single qi-aided swing of the shoulders.

name: Inferno Stonefall
description: Feed qi into both arms at once so the throw leaves the frame as a pair.

name: Eclipse Armcup
description: Cross-check the left cup against the right with a touch of qi to find which stone sits heavier.

name: Unwinddecree
description: Loose both cups so the stones part in the air and fall on two marks a body-length apart.

name: Unwindbanner
description: Strike one point twice in a short count so the second stone drives deeper into the wound of the first.

name: Solartorque
description: Draw both arms to full and cast the twin stones so they land together and shake a wide patch of ground.

name: Solararmcup
description: The school's own cast of two cups loosed so that paired stones strike as one and no mark is missed by both.

name: Bountiful Releasepin
description: Set the feet in the stance of the basin thrower with the weight low and the knees soft for the draw.

name: Bloom Skein
description: Two throwers haul one rope together and match every pull to the breath of the other.

name: Reminiscence Throwarm
description: Peg the reach of each frame in the basin so a thrower knows the paired distance.

name: Unyielding Frameside
description: Steady both frames on the basin floor with qi through the hands and the soles together.

name: Peal Unwind
description: Loose two stones in a matched lob so they fall on either side of a mark.

name: Skeingift
description: Sense the echo of a landing stone against the basin sides to judge its distance.

name: Bloom Basecradle
description: Pass the draw from one thrower to the other mid-count so the arm never rests.

name: Radiance Ballistic
description: Split the enemy's cover with one stone and send the second through the gap before it closes.

name: Splendid Torque
description: Cast paired stones onto the basin floor so the whole stretch beneath the target shakes.

name: Millstone Bombardment
description: Walk paired stones across the basin in alternate casts so no part of the ground stays safe.

name: Winchverdict
description: The school's own concord of two throwers casting in answering order so each stone readies the ground for the next.

name: Bloom Winchdrum
description: Rank the frames on the crest in a line so each spotter sees the whole row.

name: Winchgift
description: Signal the fall of each stone with a wing-arm swing so the crew reads it at a glance.

name: Bountiful Axlepin
description: Read the plume on the crest post to learn the wind that will carry the stone.

name: Serene Frameside
description: Draw both frames on the crest together with qi shared between their crews.

name: Gallant Skein
description: Loose on the down-beat of the spotter's wing signal so the throw meets its mark.

name: Steel Stoneload
description: Raise a qi screen at the crest edge against stones thrown up from below.

name: Bedrock Torque
description: Rake the slope below the crest with a cast of stones in the long sweeping line of a hawk.

name: Storied Ballistic
description: Hunt a moving target with two frames so one stone drives it and the other waits where it must go.

name: Arcflight Verdict
description: Loose both frames in a dive-aimed pair that strikes down the slope with the force of the crest behind it.

name: Gallant Pulsar Basecradle
description: The school's own dive of twin frames loosed so one stone breaks the order and the second falls into the break.

name: Winchbenison
description: Call the roll of each company on the bank so every frame and every winder is counted before the move.

name: Bloom Releasepin
description: Bind raft sleepers in two tracks so a frame can stand on either without shifting.

name: Torsion Mercy
description: Coil the track ropes in a figure of eight so they run free when the engine is hauled.

name: Interstice Winchdrum
description: Rotate the lookouts along the bank by the hour so the far shore is never left unwatched.

name: Parity Armcup
description: Draw the arm on two tracks of qi with one for the crew and one for the skeins so neither tires.

name: Gloom Stonefall
description: Throw stones at the far shore from the first raft to cover the crossing of the second raft.

name: Unwind Heraldry
description: Turn a rank of frames on the bank in one qi-aided sweep without breaking their line.

name: Basecradle Largesse
description: Sense the draw of the next company's frame and match its pace to your own.

name: Pulsar Throwarm
description: Pound one point on the far works with a measured fire from the paired companies.

name: Entropy Arcflight
description: Cast a heavy load along the far bank to overthrow the line of works the enemy has made.

name: Vaunted Bombardment
description: Bring every company to full draw and loose together so the far works open in a single blow.

name: Choral Winchdrum
description: The school's own concord of the two tracks with one company drawing the fire and the other breaking the works.

name: Parity Releasepin
description: Seat the great beam of the hawk engine in its cradle and tap it home with a padded maul.

name: Wise Skein
description: Read the sheen of a stone against the sky to tell whether frost has cracked it.

name: Unyielding Armcup
description: Brace the wing frames of the engine with paired struts before the draw begins.

name: Valiant Arcflight
description: Extend a field of qi over the engine so its crew draws without strain and without a slip.

name: Peal Torsion
description: Loose at the instant the qi field settles evenly over both wings of the engine.

name: Inviolate Frameside
description: Steady the wings of the engine through the throw with qi laid along each beam.

name: Throwarm Decree
description: Cast a heavy stone high and drop it onto the target with the full weight of the engine.

name: Skeintriumph
description: Cast a mass of stones that fall in a broad arc of blue-grey rain across a field.

name: Prismunwind
description: Pair a heavy stone with a light one so the light clears the way and the heavy follows through.

name: Heroic Steel Torque
description: The school's own great throw with the hawk engine drawn to its limit so one stone carries every beam of the frame.

name: Winchmercy
description: Settle the stance for a Core-powered draw with the weight in the legs and the breath low in the body.

name: Revelation Stoneload
description: Sort stones by the way they take the Core's energy and keep those that stay whole.

name: Axlepin Benison
description: Count each tooth of the draw so Core and crew arrive on the last tooth together.

name: Paritywinch
description: Lead the draw of the whole crew with the steady pulse of the Core so every hand matches its beat.

name: Pulsar Bombardment
description: Loft a stone that carries the energy of the Core through the whole arc of its flight.

name: Ironclad Axlepin
description: Send the energy of the Core through the frame in a slow wave to settle every joint.

name: Interstice Stoneload
description: Sense two waves of energy in the stone and shape them to fall together.

name: Steel Unwind
description: Fill a stone with Core energy at the top of its arc so it falls hard and straight.

name: Armcupbanner
description: Cast a rain of stones filled with Core energy that falls along the length of a river reach.

name: Inferno Frameside
description: Draw two engines on the pulse of one Core and loose them in step so their stones fall in a double line.

name: Intrepid Vacuum Releasepin
description: The school's own great throw with Core energy poured through paired engines so one stone strikes with the full weight of the Core.

name: Bountiful Throwarm
description: Stand at the frame with the weight low and the face to the wind in the posture of a plateau thrower.

name: Eclipse Basecradle
description: Speak the oath word on each turn of the crank and count the turns by the words.

name: Skeinbenison
description: Wet a finger and lift it to taste which way the wind runs.

name: Bloomarmcup
description: Draw the arm into the wind with qi in the legs so the frame leans and does not slide.

name: Pulsar Ballistic
description: Loose on the end of the oath word so the stone leaves with the breath of the crew.

name: Peal Skein
description: Lean the body to the bearing and feel the line of the throw before the stone is freed.

name: Evanescent Torque
description: Step clear of the arm in the pause between oath words when a gust threatens to shove the frame.

name: Quenched Unwind
description: Throw along the plateau edge so the wind keeps the stone on its line to the target.

name: Paramount Armcup
description: Cast a load on the oath word so the wind carries it wide across the field.

name: Vacuum Ballistic
description: Swear the whole crew to one throw and loose with a gale at the back so the stone strikes hard.

name: Tenet Arcflight
description: The school's own oath cast as a chain of throws on the wind with each one set up by the oath word before it.

name: Bedrock Stonefall
description: Carry the light frame on its bars at a trot with the crew keeping step.

name: Parity Torsion
description: Set a bearing stone on the ground to mark the line the frame must keep after each move.

name: Skeintroth
description: Crouch behind the frame on the wind side so blown dust covers the movements of the crew.

name: Clement Releasepin
description: Fix the frame on its bearing stone in a breath and level it by the feel of qi in the beam.

name: Winchdecree
description: Throw with the wind behind the shoulder so the stone gains from every gust.

name: Torquevoyage
description: Heave the frame to a new bearing in the moment after a throw and before the answer lands.

name: Imperial Axlepin
description: Cast a quick spread along a moving bearing so the stones keep pace with a marching line.

name: Squallskein
description: Sting a column with short throws from three bearings so it cannot say where the frame stands.

name: Gloomunwind
description: Keep a hard running barrage from a frame that moves each time before the foe can answer it.

name: Unrivaled Bombardment Banner
description: The school's own hunt of a skirmish frame shifting bearing on the wind's cue so the enemy fires at a place already left.

name: Bloomwinch
description: Speak the oath of the crew with hands on the crank and begin the draw on its last word.

name: Vigorarmcup
description: Wrap the winding rope in cloth where it passes the frame so a gale cannot fray it.

name: Gracious Torsion
description: Rotate hands at the crank on a sworn count so none tires and none breaks the oath.

name: Rooted Frameside
description: Brace shoulder to shoulder against a gale on the open plateau so the crew stands as one.

name: Solarskein
description: Hold the winding on one breath and one oath so the draw rises without a break.

name: Prism Stonefall
description: Loose into a rising gale so the stone leaves with the added force of the wind.

name: Bountiful Skein
description: Bind the qi of the crew in one oath so a tiring hand is carried by those beside it.

name: Tranquil Basecradle
description: Take a reading of the wind at the instant before release and correct the angle of the arm.

name: Fearless Winchdrum
description: Wind to the last tooth with the whole oath and loose a stone that strikes hard along its line.

name: Noble Torque
description: Cast stones into a tearing wind so they scatter in a long and unpredictable swath.

name: Quenched Stonefall
description: The crew draws as one under the oath and looses a stone carrying the full strength of every hand.

name: Destiny Winchdrum
description: The school's own winding oath that lets crew and wind work as one engine through a chain of throws.

name: Deluge Unwind
description: Haul the engine along the plateau on log rollers with the wind at the back of the crew.

name: Benevolent Armcup
description: Lay and lift the roller logs in a relay so the engine never stops moving.

name: Interstice Throwarm
description: Read the wind at the plateau edge where it is strongest and set the frame back from it.

name: Windborne Stoneload
description: Send qi through the rollers so the engine moves smoothly over rough ground.

name: Peal Ballistic
description: Time the loose to a gust coming off the edge so the wind lifts the stone.

name: Rooted Throwarm
description: Drive qi through the trail spike into the plateau so the engine stands as if rooted.

name: Pulsarunwind
description: Throw with a held gust so the stone carries well beyond the first rank into the second.

name: Magmaarmcup
description: Cast stones across the plateau so they fall from two angles at once as the wind turns them.

name: Vacuum Skein
description: Hold the engine at the plateau edge and throw with the whole edge wind behind the stone.

name: Noble Bombardment Triumph
description: The school's own release with the engine sworn to the wind so a single throw is carried far beyond any rank.

name: Torqueodyssey
description: Walk the length of the bearing of the engine and feel how the wind shifts from one end to the other.

name: Armcupmercy
description: Plait a wind rope of three strands so its pull holds true under a long gale.

name: Peal Frameside
description: Gauge the far ridge by eye over a cord and fix the pace of the throw.

name: Bountiful Winchdrum
description: Draw wind and qi together into the skeins until the arm hums with their joined force.

name: Gallant Arcflight
description: Loose with the eye on the far ridge so the stone flies the whole reach in one line.

name: Bountiful Stoneload
description: Spread a qi field into the gale and read where the wind will push the stone.

name: Tranquil Torsion
description: Tighten the wind rope with a pulse of qi at the moment of release.

name: Tempestuous Axlepin
description: Cast a train of stones along the wind so each falls farther than the last and the ridge is raked.

name: Paramount Ballistic
description: Loose a stone whose line the gale holds so it pierces the van of a distant host.

name: Vaunted Releasepin
description: Lay the whole draw and the wind into one stone that crosses the plateau to its far end.

name: Exalted Unwind Edict
description: The school's own reach that sends one great stone across the full reach and lets it fall on an open host.

name: Solarwinch
description: Hold the posture that lets the Core and the wind share one breath.

name: Skeinmercy
description: Read the open sky for the weather that will carry the throw.

name: Parityskein
description: Speak the oath of the Core to the draw and begin on its last word.

name: Compassionate Basecradle
description: Pull the wind through the Core into the arm so the draw is lifted by both.

name: Unwindcrown
description: Loose with the pulse of the Core at its crest so the stone rides the sky.

name: Winchdrum Pledge
description: Settle the frame with a slow wave of Core and wind through every beam.

name: Radiance Arcflight
description: Fill the stone with Core and gale together so it pierces a line of shields at long range.

name: Magma Torque
description: Cast a hail of stones sworn to the wind so they fall wherever the gale carries them across the field.

name: Thunderclap Throwarm
description: Join the oath and the Core in one draw and loose a stone that holds its bearing to the end of its flight.

name: Demolition Armcup
description: The school's own throw with Core and wind sworn together so a stone crosses open sky and falls on one marked ground.
